withdraw money: I need to stop at the ATM to withdraw money before we go to the night market.
我們去夜市之前，我需要先到提款機提款。
withdraw from the race: After hurting his ankle during practice, the runner had to withdraw from the race the next morning.
練習時扭傷腳踝後，那名跑者隔天早上不得不退出比賽。
withdraw support: When the company was caught polluting the river, many customers decided to withdraw support and stopped buying its products.
那家公司被抓到污染河川後，許多顧客決定撤回支持，不再購買它的產品。
withdraw troops: After the peace talks, both countries agreed to withdraw troops from the border within three months.
和平談判後，兩國同意在三個月內從邊境撤軍。
withdraw a statement: The politician was forced to withdraw a statement after people found out that it was completely false.
民眾發現那份聲明完全不實後，這位政治人物被迫收回聲明。
withdraw into oneself: After moving to a new school, Amy began to withdraw into herself and seldom talked to anyone.
轉到新學校後，艾咪開始封閉自我，很少跟任何人說話。
withdraw an offer: The company may withdraw an offer of a job if you fail to reply within one week.
如果你一週內沒有回覆，公司可能會撤回工作的錄取提議。
wither away: Without anyone to take care of it, the old garden began to wither away year after year.
沒有人照顧，這座老花園一年又一年地逐漸凋零。
hopes withered: As the rain kept falling all week, our hopes withered for a sunny day at the beach.
雨下了一整個星期，我們想在海灘度過晴天的希望也枯萎了。
wither under criticism: Some young singers wither under criticism online, while others use it to become stronger.
有些年輕歌手在網路批評下退縮，而有些人則把它當成變得更堅強的動力。
a withering look: When I talked loudly in the library, the librarian gave me a withering look full of disgust.
我在圖書館大聲說話時，圖書館員給了我一個充滿厭惡的鄙視眼神。
plants wither: If you forget to water them during the hot summer, plants wither in just a few days.
如果你在炎熱的夏天忘記澆水，植物短短幾天就會枯萎。
the industry withered: After cheap goods arrived from abroad, the local silk industry withered slowly, like a plant without water.
國外的便宜商品進來後，當地的絲綢產業就像缺水的植物一樣慢慢萎縮。
witness a crime: If you witness a crime on the street, you should call the police and tell them what you saw.
如果你在街上目擊犯罪，應該打電話報警並告訴他們你看到了什麼。
witness history: Thousands of people gathered in the square to witness history as the first woman president gave her speech.
數千人聚集在廣場上，見證第一位女總統發表演說的歷史時刻。
witness a change: Over the past ten years, our town has witnessed a change from quiet farmland to busy shopping streets.
過去十年來，我們的小鎮見證了從安靜農田變成熱鬧商店街的改變。
witness a signature: A lawyer had to witness a signature on the contract, watching my father sign it and then signing his own name.
律師必須為合約上的簽名作見證，看著我父親簽名後再簽上他自己的名字。
the year witnessed: The year witnessed huge changes in how students learn, as many classes moved online for the first time.
這一年見證了學生學習方式的巨大改變，許多課程第一次改為線上進行。
wonder about the future: Many seniors in high school often wonder about the future and worry about which college they will attend.
許多高三生常常思索未來，也擔心自己會上哪一所大學。
wonder at the beauty: Even now, I still wonder at the beauty of the sunset that I saw in Kenting ten years ago.
即使到現在，我仍然驚嘆十年前在墾丁看到的那場夕陽有多美。
I wonder if: I wonder if it will rain tomorrow, because we have planned a picnic by the river.
不知道明天是否會下雨，因為我們計畫要去河邊野餐。
no wonder: You stayed up playing games until four in the morning; no wonder you are so tired today.
你打電動打到凌晨四點，難怪你今天這麼累。
work wonders: A short walk after lunch can work wonders for your mood and help you focus in afternoon classes.
午餐後短暫散步對你的心情效果奇佳，還能幫助你在下午的課專心。
small wonder: He practiced the piano for six hours every day, so it is small wonder that he won first prize.
他每天練琴六個小時，所以他得到第一名不足為奇。
word a letter carefully: Since the customer was very angry, the manager had to word a letter carefully to avoid upsetting him more.
因為那位顧客非常生氣，經理寫信時必須措辭謹慎，以免讓他更不高興。
be worded strongly: The warning on the box was worded strongly so that parents would keep the medicine away from children.
盒子上的警語措辭強烈，好讓家長把藥放在孩子拿不到的地方。
word of mouth: The small noodle shop never advertised, but it became popular through word of mouth among students.
這家小麵店從來不打廣告，卻靠學生之間口耳相傳而變得很受歡迎。
keep one's word: Dad promised to take us to the zoo on Sunday, and he always keeps his word.
爸爸答應星期天帶我們去動物園，而他總是守信。
have a word with: Could I have a word with you after class? I have a question about the homework.
下課後可以跟你談談嗎？我有一個關於作業的問題。
in other words: The test is next Monday; in other words, we have only five days left to review everything.
考試在下星期一；換句話說，我們只剩五天可以複習所有內容。
word for word: Don't copy the article word for word; try to explain the ideas in your own words instead.
不要逐字抄寫這篇文章，試著改用你自己的話來解釋其中的想法。
